sweet-mokka.name: Sweet Mokka
sweet-mokka.stats: +30 stamina, +6% ranged and dagger damage (55 min)

transcendental-screen.name: Transcendental Screen
transcendental-screen.stats: Block / parry 7 / 51; Magic ward: +4 Mana regen, +10% Shock resistance

a-beehive-smoker.name: A Beehive Smoker
a-beehive-smoker.summary: Needs the Tanning Station, Black Cauldron and Almanac quests done. Check Emily Fray's tavern in Brittlebush, follow the honey shipment route near East Lapis, and beat the Vukah honey thief at Vukah Sacrifice Hill to get the smoker back. Place it at base.

a-black-cauldron-for-the-alchemist.name: A Black Cauldron For The Alchemist
a-black-cauldron-for-the-alchemist.summary: Ask the Farmer about the sorcerer Ikora, visit her empty shop in Rattlebleak, then follow the calcified statues to the Cradle of Dusk and defeat her. Take the Black Cauldron from her remains and craft an Alchemy Station.

a-blast-furnace-for-the-blacksmith.name: A Blast Furnace For The Blacksmith
a-blast-furnace-for-the-blacksmith.summary: After Gathering Wool In The Albaneve Summits, find the Forge of Obsidia, fight through the Scavengers to the heart of the forge and take the bellows. Craft the Blast Furnace at base.

a-cure-for-the-fell-curse.giver: Starts when you get the Fell Curse
a-cure-for-the-fell-curse.name: A Cure For The Fell Curse
a-cure-for-the-fell-curse.summary: Talk to the Alchemist. Gather the cure ingredients from Fell enemy groups that roam above the Shroud at night, craft a Fell Curse Cleansing Tonic (2 Fresh Shroud Spores) and drink it.

a-graceful-flight.name: A Graceful Flight
a-graceful-flight.summary: After rescuing the Carpenter, gather the Advanced Glider ingredients (it needs linen) and craft the Advanced Glider at the Carpenter.

a-lighthouse-in-sunless-seas.name: A Lighthouse In Sunless Seas
a-lighthouse-in-sunless-seas.reward: 75 XP; fast-travel point and new map markers
a-lighthouse-in-sunless-seas.summary: After Emerald Shores And Sanguine Seas, climb the Veilwater Basin Ancient Spire.

a-spinning-machine-for-the-hunter.name: A Spinning Machine For The Hunter
a-spinning-machine-for-the-hunter.summary: Once you have Raw Wool (from yaks in the Albaneve Summits), craft a Spinning Machine at the Hunter, place it at base and spin the wool. Then craft warm padding kits at the Hunter for cold protection.

a-story-of-fire.name: A Story Of Fire
a-story-of-fire.summary: Unlocks after Flame Altar And Base Improvements 1. Go to the Springlands Obelisk of the Flame (marked on your map) and interact with it to read it.

a-story-of-rot.name: A Story Of Rot
a-story-of-rot.summary: Unlocks after Flame Altar And Base Improvements 1. Go to the Springlands Obelisk of the Shroud (marked on your map) and interact with it to read it.

a-time-for-harvest.name: A Time For Harvest
a-time-for-harvest.summary: Needs level 8, the Farmer rescued and berries in your bag. Bring the Farmer strawberries (grown or found in Revelwood) and she tells you about buried treasure. Dig it up in the trash pit at Glennwood's End.

a-tool-for-underwater-mining.name: A Tool For Underwater Mining
a-tool-for-underwater-mining.summary: After Emerald Shores And Sanguine Seas, go to Orville (overrun by Drak'Dal), search the town for clues, then swim out to the nearby shipwrecks to find the Mining Sieve.

among-the-bluejays.name: Among The Bluejays
among-the-bluejays.summary: After Sun Temple Stories, find the legendary glider marked at the Scatterbone camp beside an ancient Sun Temple, then go into the temple to get it. Needed before Ignite The Snowy Mountaintops.

an-eternal-spell.name: An Eternal Spell
an-eternal-spell.summary: After Staffs And Spells, find the Hidden Tomb Entry (an underground grave), go inside and take the eternal spell. Eternal spells never run out when used as staff ammo.

animal-farming.name: Animal Farming
animal-farming.summary: Make three goat food baits with the Farmer. Lure and feed a wild goat, pet it until it trusts you, pick it up and place it at base. Build a goat feeder and an animal bed. Two happy animals with a spare bed will breed.

beds-and-shelter.name: Beds And Shelter
beds-and-shelter.summary: Assign a bed to Fenrig with the Summoning Staff.

bring-back-the-pure-souls.name: Bring Back The Pure Souls
bring-back-the-pure-souls.summary: Needs the Farmer and Carpenter rescued. Search the marked area at Fenrig's Farm, then explore Wolf Cave, where a note leads you to Fenrig. Summon him at base from the Summoning Staff's Assistants tab and talk to him.

building-shelter.name: Building Shelter
building-shelter.summary: Craft Rough Stone Blocks (2 Stone makes 100) and a Construction Hammer (1 Stone). Near your Flame Altar, place a block in building mode, then craft and place a Fireplace (6 Stone, 2 Wood Logs). The hammer only works inside an altar's area.

capybara-search-and-rescue.giver: Starts from a capybara corpse at Capybara Oasis
capybara-search-and-rescue.name: Capybara Search And Rescue
capybara-search-and-rescue.summary: Loot the capybara corpse at Capybara Oasis, then find and clear the Drak'Dal capybara-hunting camp. You can save surviving capybaras.

carpentry-assistance.name: Carpentry Assistance
carpentry-assistance.summary: Carpenter's Ancient Vault in the Shroud. Blast the blocked passage with explosives, then summon Cade Hawthorn.

claim-a-spot-for-your-base.name: Claim A Spot For Your Base
claim-a-spot-for-your-base.summary: Reach the Plains, build a Flame Altar (5 Stone), talk to the Flame.

clear-the-elixir-well.name: Clear The Elixir Well
clear-the-elixir-well.summary: Defeat the Fell Thunderbrute and break the Shroud Root with an axe.

cooking-equipment-for-the-farmer.name: Cooking Equipment For The Farmer
cooking-equipment-for-the-farmer.summary: Unlocks after Crucible Needed For A Smelter. You need Shroud passage level 3 (from Flame upgrades) to reach Pikemead's Reach. Find the Kettle in the Flame Sanctum there, then craft and place a Cooking Station and a Kitchen at base.

cooking-warm-food.name: Cooking Warm Food
cooking-warm-food.summary: After Gathering Wool, cook a warming dish such as pumpkin soup, grilled fatty meat or beef stew.

crucible-needed-for-a-smelter.name: Crucible Needed For A Smelter
crucible-needed-for-a-smelter.summary: Retrieve the Crucible from the Mark of Sameth mine and craft a Smelter.

daggers-for-the-bard.name: Daggers For The Bard
daggers-for-the-bard.summary: After the Bard has a bed, go to the Snapjaw Tar Pits and search the lower levels (beast territory) for Valory's dagger, then bring it back.

emerald-shores-and-sanguine-seas.name: Emerald Shores And Sanguine Seas
emerald-shores-and-sanguine-seas.summary: Needs Illuminate The Night and Flame level 8. Take the passage into the Veilwater Basin, head to the Veilwater Basin Outlook, search the Ol' Salt 'N Pepper tavern for clues, then go to Ol' Captain's Rest and find the remains on the island nearby. Summon the Fisher, Melville Fontaine, at base.

eternally-piercing.name: Eternally Piercing
eternally-piercing.summary: After Daggers For The Bard, search the Hermit Camp for the enchanted arrows. Careful: don't read the lore note or grab the arrow there before you have this quest, or the quest can break.

explore-the-hollow-halls.name: Explore The Hollow Halls
explore-the-hollow-halls.summary: Reach Collector Alden Crowley's pod in the Hollow Halls and summon him.

farmers-advice.name: Farmer's Advice
farmers-advice.summary: Put a raw fish on your hotbar, cook it at a campfire (hold, then release), then eat the grilled fish from your backpack. Unknown Waters teaches you how to fish.

fast-travel.name: Fast Travel
fast-travel.summary: Unlocks after The Ancient Spires. Light the Springlands Ancient Spire, then open the map and fast travel to it. Only offered if you haven't fast traveled yet, so don't use an altar or spire to travel before finishing The Ancient Spires.

find-the-sleeping-survivor.name: Find The Sleeping Survivor
find-the-sleeping-survivor.summary: Cross the Shroud and wake the Blacksmith, then summon him to your base.

finding-and-using-a-gem-forge.name: Finding And Using A Gem Forge
finding-and-using-a-gem-forge.summary: Clear a Shroud Lair east of the Ancient Spire and defeat the Fell Banshee.

finding-masonry-tools.name: Finding Masonry Tools
finding-masonry-tools.summary: After the Table Saw and Reach The Capital quests, go through the gate to the Pillars of Creation and search the excavation camps (the research camp) for the Masonry Tools. Bring them to the Carpenter. You may need to check several camps.

flame-altar-and-base-improvements-1.name: Flame Altar And Base Improvements 1
flame-altar-and-base-improvements-1.reward: Flame 2: 4 altars, 6 min Shroud time, +1 attribute bonus
flame-altar-and-base-improvements-1.summary: Take the Spark from the Flame Sanctum west of Braelyn Bridge and Strengthen the Flame (5 Resin, 5 Penny Bun, 5 Bones, 5 Shroud Liquid, 5 Animal Fur).

flame-altar-and-base-improvements-2.name: Flame Altar And Base Improvements 2
flame-altar-and-base-improvements-2.summary: Upgrade the altar with a Shroud Core, then build a second altar.

follow-the-melody.name: Follow The Melody
follow-the-melody.summary: Ancient Spire in Blackmire, then press three buttons in the Sunken Ancient City. Summon Valory.

forge-weaponry-or-armor.name: Forge Weaponry Or Armor
forge-weaponry-or-armor.summary: Talk to the Blacksmith, choose Craft and make any weapon or armor piece. Cheap option: Fur Boots (2 Torn Cloth, 1 Animal Fur, 2 String). Afterward the Blacksmith offers the Glider quest.

gathering-wool-in-the-albaneve-summits.name: Gathering Wool In The Albaneve Summits
gathering-wool-in-the-albaneve-summits.summary: After Ignite The Snowy Mountaintops, make at least 3 yak food baits, find the yak herd near the Quiet Caves and tame one. Any yak counts.

glider.name: Glider
glider.summary: Given by the Blacksmith after Forge Weaponry Or Armor. Craft a Glider at the Workbench: 8 Shroud Wood (from inside the Shroud), 2 Animal Fur, 2 String, 2 Shroud Spores. Gliding drains stamina, so land before it runs out.

growing-stronger-together.name: Growing Stronger Together
growing-stronger-together.summary: Farmer's Ancient Vault north of Braelyn Bridge. Press three buttons, then summon Emily Fray. Needs the grappling hook.

hannah-reed-needs-help.name: Hannah Reed Needs Help
hannah-reed-needs-help.summary: Go to Vukah Ceremony Hill and beat the Vukah Brawler (shooting it from the grassy rock ledge works well). Then find Marianne Reed's remains by the wooden bridge and collect her soul.

helping-hands.name: Helping Hands
helping-hands.reward: Aunt Braelyn's soul; optional gold chest on the top floor
helping-hands.summary: In the hidden temples around the Blackmire Ancient Spire. Grapple across the black mud to the first temple panel, follow the marker northwest to a glowing note, then cross the pillars in the temple west of the spire. On the second floor, grapple to Aunt Braelyn's remains and collect her soul. Black mud can kill you.

hidden-flame-shrine.name: Hidden Flame Shrine
hidden-flame-shrine.summary: Starts when you read the lore note "Can It Be True?". Explore the Flame Shrine of Manathor in the Kindlewastes and collect the Spark inside.

hunter-becomes-the-hunted.name: Hunter Becomes The Hunted
hunter-becomes-the-hunted.summary: Vault east of the Springlands Ancient Spire, past electric traps. Summon Athalan Skree.

ignite-the-coldest-elixir-well.name: Ignite The Coldest Elixir Well
ignite-the-coldest-elixir-well.reward: Fell Cyclops Head (Flame upgrade); Elixir Well gives 3 skill points
ignite-the-coldest-elixir-well.summary: After A Spinning Machine For The Hunter and Cooking Warm Food, reach the main Albaneve Elixir Well, defeat the Evil Eye monsters inside and clear it. Use the Fell Cyclops Head to strengthen the Flame.

ignite-the-snowy-mountaintops.name: Ignite The Snowy Mountaintops
ignite-the-snowy-mountaintops.summary: Needs Shroud passage level 6 and Among The Bluejays done. Go through the Mountaincave Passage into the Albaneve Summits, ignite the Ancient Spire, climb to the top and speak to the Flame.

illuminate-the-night.name: Illuminate The Night
illuminate-the-night.summary: Just east of Fort Kelvin, drop off the cliff into the Shroud to Elder's Night Sanctum. The round door opens only at night. Get through the spike and fireball corridor, press the glowing button to open the gate and wake the Barber, Elio Ricci. Summon him at base. The room with the pink light refills your Shroud timer and becomes your respawn point.

in-need-of-a-tanning-station.name: In Need Of A Tanning Station
in-need-of-a-tanning-station.summary: Ask the Carpenter, who knows a hunter from the Nomad Highlands. Explore Raven's Keep, then take the Tanning Station from Lupa's Lair and place it at base.

increasing-your-follower-amount-and-flam.name: Increasing Your Follower Amount And Flame Level
increasing-your-follower-amount-and-flam.reward: Flame level 3; Fenrig's Axe recipe at the Blacksmith
increasing-your-follower-amount-and-flam.summary: Give beds to at least 2 survivors, then gather 10 Wax, 10 Salt, 5 Sparks, 10 Shroud Wood, 10 Flintstone, 25 Mycelium and the Scavenger Matron Helmet (from the Scavenger Gorger Matron at the Hill of Scavengers). Strengthen the Flame at your altar. Only materials in your backpack count.

loom-for-the-hunter.name: Loom For The Hunter
loom-for-the-hunter.summary: After the Tanning Station and Black Cauldron quests, find the weaver's cottage with banners in East Lapis, search inside for the Loom and place it at base.

lord-vorgoths-throneroom.name: Lord Vorgoth's Throneroom
lord-vorgoths-throneroom.reward: Large Stone Arc and Stone Column building pieces, 75 XP
lord-vorgoths-throneroom.summary: Read the note "To The Castle!" in Chester Loft's loft in Cromville, then search Lord Vorgoth's trophy collection in the Cromville throne room.

making-a-home.name: Making A Home
making-a-home.summary: Craft a Crude Mattress at the Workbench (3 String, 4 Torn Cloth, 4 Plant Fiber). Then sit at a fire, hold to cook some meat and eat the Grilled Lean Meat. Tip: if your hotbar is full, eat it from the backpack with Use Item.

nice-day-for-fishing.name: Nice Day For Fishing
nice-day-for-fishing.summary: Catch frogs in the Veilwater grass, have the Fisher craft an Excellent Fishing Rod, then catch an epic fish using frog bait. Fishing Island has the best odds.

powerful-alchemy.name: Powerful Alchemy
powerful-alchemy.summary: Alchemist's Ancient Vault west of the Ancient Spire. Wake Balthazar; gold chest inside.

reach-the-capital-pikemeads-reach.name: Reach The Capital, Pikemead's Reach
reach-the-capital-pikemeads-reach.summary: After the Smelter quest, travel to Pikemead's Reach, cross the town into The Pike castle behind it and kill the beast inside.

reclaim-the-wilderness.name: Reclaim The Wilderness
reclaim-the-wilderness.reward: 200 XP; Revelwood spire becomes a fast-travel point
reclaim-the-wilderness.summary: At the Revelwood Ancient Spire, north of the Springlands spire. Ride the glowing platform up, flip two wall switches past the fire and electric traps, shoot four high switches with a bow, then two more on the next floor and two by the stairs. Commune with the Flame at the top. Wait for spikes to retract before crossing.

ringing-in-the-new-year.name: Ringing In The New Year
ringing-in-the-new-year.summary: East of the Hunter's Ancient Vault in the Shroud; collect Mei-Yin Chen's soul from the wagon.

salt-mine-location.name: Salt Mine Location
salt-mine-location.summary: After rescuing the Hunter, he points you to the Egerton Salt Mines. Travel there and mine Salt, which you need to preserve fur.

salvage-and-enhance.name: Salvage And Enhance
salvage-and-enhance.summary: Unlocks after The Ancient Spires. Salvage a higher-rarity weapon to get Runes, then spend Runes at the Blacksmith to upgrade a weapon.

scientific-instruments-for-a-laboratory.name: Scientific Instruments For A Laboratory
scientific-instruments-for-a-laboratory.summary: Needs the Tanning Station, Black Cauldron and Almanac quests done. Search the Obelisk Excavation Camp for clues about Loraine Crim, then the Eldermere Dam Excavation Camp to recover her instruments. Craft a Laboratory at the Alchemist.

slaying-the-corrupted-beast.name: Slaying The Corrupted Beast
slaying-the-corrupted-beast.reward: Fell Dragon Youngling Head, 150 XP; the Flame upgrade makes altars keep the cold away while you build
slaying-the-corrupted-beast.summary: After the Coldest Elixir Well, light all 8 balefires, starting at Balefire Garrison Silkfrost and ending at Everfrore Keep. Then fight the Fell Dragon Youngling on Howling Peak. Some of its attacks can be parried. Its health was cut in 1.0.

spend-a-skill-point.name: Spend A Skill Point
spend-a-skill-point.summary: Open the skill tree (H), pick any node next to a starting point and unlock it. Each Elixir Well gives 3 points and each Shroud Root 1. Respec at the Flame Altar costs runes.

staffs-and-spells.name: Staffs And Spells
staffs-and-spells.summary: After the Alchemist has a bed, craft the Alchemist's staff. It needs Shroud Wood from inside the Shroud.

table-saw-for-the-carpenter.name: Table Saw For The Carpenter
table-saw-for-the-carpenter.summary: Collect Circular Sawblades at Thornhold, craft and place the Table Saw.

the-alchemists-mortar.name: The Alchemist's Mortar
the-alchemists-mortar.summary: Alchemist Tower north of Braelyn Bridge; press the upstairs button and bring the Mortar to base.

the-alchemists-rumors.name: The Alchemist's Rumors
the-alchemists-rumors.summary: Defeat the Scavenger Gorger Matron at the Hill of Scavengers.

the-ancient-spires.name: The Ancient Spires
the-ancient-spires.summary: Climb the Ancient Spire near Braelyn Bridge and speak to the Flame at the top.

the-blacksmiths-family.name: The Blacksmith's Family
the-blacksmiths-family.summary: After Bring Back The Pure Souls and The Blacksmith's Request, go to Fanning Ranch (marked on the map) and search the ruined shed to rescue Rochelle's soul.

the-dragons-last-breath.giver: Starts when you find a Dragon's Map Piece
the-dragons-last-breath.name: The Dragons' Last Breath
the-dragons-last-breath.summary: Collect all 4 Dragon's Map Pieces, combine them into the map and follow it to the Forgotten Temple behind a waterfall. Door switch settings: Mae on-off-off, Ony on-on-on, Orpheus off-off-off, Polaris off-on-off.

the-hunters-hand-spindle.name: The Hunter's Hand Spindle
the-hunters-hand-spindle.summary: Cross the bridge past Willow Crush near Westcott to the spider cave; place the Hand Spindle at base.

the-kindlewastes-hollow-halls.name: The Kindlewastes Hollow Halls
the-kindlewastes-hollow-halls.summary: Needs Shroud passage level 5 and The Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls done. Craft the key at the Collector, fight down to the end, then master the halls. Bring your best glider and as much Shroud time as you can.

the-nomad-highlands-hollow-halls.name: The Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls
the-nomad-highlands-hollow-halls.summary: Needs level 17 and the Collector's Ectoplasm Press. Craft the Hollow Halls key at the Collector, then fight down to the bottom of the Nomad Highlands Hollow Halls. It's tough solo, so bring your best gear and potions.

the-oasis.name: The Oasis
the-oasis.summary: Starts from the lore note "A Hopeful Beginning". Follow the traveler's notes and map to a small oasis in the Kindlewastes (easiest by glider). The marker leads to a tiny cave in a patch of Shroud, where you dig up a gold chest.

unknown-waters.name: Unknown Waters
unknown-waters.summary: Catch fireflies at night, craft a Simple Fishing Rod, show the Hunter a fish.

veilwater-basin-flame-upgrade.name: Veilwater Basin Flame Upgrade
veilwater-basin-flame-upgrade.reward: Flame upgrade; opens the deeper Veilwater Basin
veilwater-basin-flame-upgrade.summary: Get a Hydrak'Dal Head, speak with the Flame at your altar and use the head (plus other materials) to strengthen the Flame. The full material list isn't published yet.

vukah-ceremony.name: Vukah Ceremony
vukah-ceremony.summary: Needs level 7 and the Carpenter rescued. Go to Vukah Ceremony Hill in the Low Meadows, check the Vukah camp and defeat their champion, the Vukah Brawler.

we-the-only-ones.name: We, The Only Ones
we-the-only-ones.summary: Fenrig suggests searching Fort Kelvin, northeast of the Springlands Ancient Spire. Climb in over the rocks and netting by the barred gate, then use the Improved Grappling Hook on the anchor on the tower's outer ledge (jumping won't reach). Collect Hannah Reed's soul from the skeleton at the top.
